key_concepts: Biotechnology is the manipulation of organisms or their components to make useful products
Karl Ereky coined the term biotechnology in 1919.
Traditional biotechnology includes products made through fermentation.
Fermentation is the breakdown of glucose without oxygen.
Aerobic respiration requires oxygen and produces carbon dioxide, water, and ATP.
Anaerobic respiration does not require oxygen.
The two types of fermentation are alcoholic fermentation and lactic acid fermentation.
Yogurt, kimchi, bagoong, and probiotic milk are examples of fermented products.
Lactic acid fermentation produces lactic acid and energy.
Yeast fermentation can be investigated experimentally using sugar.
